criteria.reason: Corrected experientscha, planisaziun, correspundan, furniziun but missed coordinatour.
Heavily reworded: dunna→Signora, scriv→Scrivo, segir→sicher, plazza→posiziun, reducì→ridut, menà→guidà, legrass→liet.
Mostly Rumantsch Grischun but inserts Italian (Signora, Scrivo, Ho) and German (sicher).

summary: Corrected four of five spelling errors but extensively reworded the letter and mixed in non-Rumantsch words, breaching the no-change constraint.
